direction.content_form: A diagonal printing-to-reading paper field crosses a tall left title/information spine. The English entry appears once on the actual shared sheet.
direction.whole_expression_style: Assertive constructed culture: heavy compact Korean, flat cut planes and adult profiles. An active crossing field meets a stable joining-information spine.
direction.reference_transfer: Feixen: continuous movement links type, image and ground; rebuild it as a functional sheet/impression, without ribbons, grid or cropped letters. Mut: one event hierarchy binds making and reading; people replace the bloom.

layout.large_relationship: Left 42%: title and eight practical rows. Right 53%: diagonal shared sheet/table with readers above and rubber contact below. Activity sits at the upper image edge. Only nontext planes leave the frame.
layout.alignment: Title and practical rows share x28. Activity starts x323. English sits on a broad horizontal reader-facing paper area.
layout.visible_reading_route: First two-line Korean title; next date/time directly below on the same left spine, then place, entry, fee, application, preparation and welcome without searching. Activity at upper right leads into the connected printing/reading scene.

typography.roles: Title: straight-sided compact grotesk, 49 px on two word-group lines. Facts: open humanist sans 17 px/21 px rows, tabular figures. Activity: 19 px medium. Page English: broad upright display capitals, 23 px. Essential letters have solid clean strokes.
typography.image_type_boundary: Title/facts use flat ground; English belongs only to the held sheet. Hands and relief marks stay outside text boxes.

image.scene: Flat cut illustration. Two adult upper-body profiles at upper right share a broad page: one speaks, both look at its English line. A visible lower-right forearm lifts an edge of a thick carved rubber slab from the paper.
image.action_relation: The same asymmetric nonletter relief pattern appears on inked rubber underside, fresh adjacent impression and reader-held end. Paper remains one connected object. Fingers grip the clean slab edge; rubber thickness, contact gap and transferred mark are separate. Two readers support the same sheet with visible gaze/mouths.
image.crop: Bodies may enter at right/bottom. Retain eyes, mouths, gripping fingers, slab thickness, paper edge and full impression; heads 65–80 px, block/imprint 60–85 px.

direction.material: Flat ink-like planes; controlled relief cuts only in nontext marks. Smooth readable type; no decorative tape.
direction.color: Citron ground, near-black type/hands, deep petrol planes and pale reading paper. Contrast directs the spine and contact.
direction.emotion: Energetic adult neighbourhood culture, made approachable by attentive faces and the readable welcome.

copy_groups.line_plan: 2 lines; break after word 1; 58 px baseline step; widest ≈196 px.
8 rows at 21 px; height ≈164 px; widest ≈226 of 276 px.

nearest_direction_difference.stripped_material_color_test: M1 retains upper-left title, lower-left full practical spine and a diagonal right action field. M5 retains a centred tall text-bearing sheet flanked by huge opposing profiles. First anchor, symmetry, facts and scene scale differ without colour/material.

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.

Rubber-block printing onto paper and shared reading of that printed work must be visibly connected, with an approachable adult cultural-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
